mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 66 degrees and clear near Verona Area High School under a Waxing Gibbous moon. Tonight, you can catch the ISS passing overhead at 5:49 PM, moving from the Northwest near Middleton toward the Northeast near Madison.

The City of Verona has announced that city buildings will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27, which means trash and recycling pickup will be delayed. Additionally, the city is planning for an expanded public works facility to handle our growing population.
We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today, plus more live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, and plenty of trivia nights kicking off next Tuesday.
In our weekly report, on November 2, officers were called to the 100 block of West End Circle where they arrested a 48-year-old local man for battery and disorderly conduct.
The flavor of the day is the delightful Crazy for Cookie Dough, and since the store is open until 10:30 PM, you have plenty of time to head over and enjoy a scoop.
